xna-type.name: Song
xna-type.summary: Provides access to a song in the song library.
xna-type.remarks: The Song class provides information about a song, including the song's Name , Artist , and Album . You can obtain a Song object through the SongCollection.Item indexer and the MediaQueue.ActiveSong property.

property.name: Album
property.summary: Gets the Album on which the Song appears.

property.name: Artist
property.summary: Gets the Artist of the Song.

property.name: Duration
property.summary: Gets the duration of the Song.

property.name: Genre
property.summary: Gets the Genre of the Song.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the object is disposed.

property.name: IsProtected
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates whether the song is DRM protected content.

property.name: IsRated
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates whether the song has been rated by the user.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the name of the Song.

property.name: Rating
property.summary: Gets the user's rating for the Song.

property.name: TrackNumber
property.summary: Gets the track number of the song on the song's Album.

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Song is reclaimed by garbage collection.

overload.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Song is reclaimed by garbage collection.
overload.remarks: This method overrides Finalize System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. The object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection, unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method has disabled finalization by the garbage collector. For more information, see Finalize Methods and Destructors , Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources , and Overriding the Finalize Method .
